$comment: Single source for the project showcase: weidhaus.com reads this file, README.md is generated from it (node scripts/build-readme.mjs). Entries with caseStudy: true have a German case study in case-studies/<id>.md. Client entries stay anonymous until the client agrees to be named.

projects.name: Vertriebsautomatisierung
projects.pitch_de: Leads aus Telefonie, Formularen und Tabellen landen automatisch im CRM, mit Status-Updates und Nachfass-Logik.
projects.summary_en: Lead import, call tagging, deal-stage logic and follow-up tasks for a sales team, built on n8n and Pipedrive.

projects.name: Lead-Sync
projects.pitch_de: Neue Leads gehen alle 5 Minuten aus der Tabelle an das Partnersystem, jede Lieferung ist nachweisbar.
projects.summary_en: Unattended spreadsheet-to-API lead forwarder with idempotent delivery, stored proof of every request and ntfy alerts.

projects.name: Meetfacts
projects.pitch_de: Meetings aufnehmen und transkribieren, komplett lokal auf dem Mac.
projects.summary_en: Local-first macOS meeting recorder: mic and system audio as separate tracks, on-device transcription, speaker-tagged transcripts.

projects.name: HoldFn
projects.pitch_de: Diktieren per Tastendruck, der Text erscheint am Cursor, ohne Cloud.
projects.summary_en: Push-to-talk dictation daemon for macOS with on-device transcription; text is inserted at the cursor.

projects.name: steuerdocs
projects.pitch_de: KI sortiert alle Belege eines Steuerjahres in Paperless vor, Unsicheres landet in einer Prüfliste.
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted LLM triage for Paperless-NGX: tags every document of a tax year, recall-first, with a review queue.

projects.name: meetartifacts
projects.pitch_de: Meeting-Notizen landen automatisch beim passenden Deal im CRM.
projects.summary_en: Matches meeting notes to CRM deals and uploads them, with Google Calendar integration.

projects.name: Gmail Signature Manager
projects.pitch_de: Einheitliche E-Mail-Signaturen für das ganze Unternehmen, zentral gepflegt.
projects.summary_en: Google Apps Script that deploys templated, branded Gmail signatures across a Workspace domain.

projects.name: identflow
projects.pitch_de: Mitarbeiterdaten aus Personio automatisch in Google Workspace.
projects.summary_en: Identity sync from Personio to Google Workspace, with Keycloak OIDC login; in production use.

projects.name: Regalplaner 3D
projects.pitch_de: Regale kostenlos im Browser in 3D planen.
projects.summary_en: Browser-based 3D shelf planner on a single Cloudflare Worker with D1.

projects.name: Gartenplaner 3D
projects.pitch_de: Den eigenen Garten im Browser in 3D planen, mit Mengenliste.
projects.summary_en: Browser-based 3D garden planner: terrain, house, plants, paths, quantity list; runs fully client-side.

projects.name: Chronato
projects.pitch_de: Kimai-Zeiterfassung direkt in der Mac-Menüleiste und auf dem iPhone.
projects.summary_en: Native Kimai 2 time-tracking client for the macOS menu bar and iPhone.

projects.name: ntfy inbox
projects.pitch_de: Archiv und Suche für einen eigenen ntfy-Server, mit lesendem KI-Zugriff.
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted topic inventory and searchable report archive for your own ntfy server, with read-only MCP tools.
